description: This file contains class definitions for rendering chart components in a PDF charting library. It manages rendering info for chart elements such as axes, data points, series, legends, and plot areas, facilitating efficient rendering and calculations related to charts.

classes.name: RendererInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for all renderer information classes, serving as a common ancestor.

classes.name: AreaRendererInfo
classes.description: Base class for renderer info that defines an area, with properties for position and size (X, Y, Width, Height, Size, Rect).

classes.name: ChartRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains rendering info for a chart, including axis info, plot area, legend, series, and default fonts.

classes.name: CombinationRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores information for rendering combined charts, including series grouping.

classes.name: PointRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents individual data point rendering info, including position, line, and fill format.

classes.name: SectorRendererInfo
classes.description: Specialized data point for pie chart sectors, with geometry info.

classes.name: ColumnRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents a bar or column data point with its rectangle.

classes.name: DataLabelEntryRendererInfo
classes.description: Rendering info for individual data labels.

classes.name: DataLabelRendererInfo
classes.description: Holds info for rendering data labels, including font, format, and position.

classes.name: SeriesRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains all rendering info related to a data series, including points and formatting.

classes.name: MarkerRendererInfo
classes.description: Describes a marker used in line charts.

classes.name: AxisRendererInfo
classes.description: Holds axis-specific rendering info, including scale, tick marks, gridlines, and labels.

classes.name: AxisTitleRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains rendering info for an axis title, such as font and orientation.

classes.name: LegendEntryRendererInfo
classes.description: Info for a legend entry's rendering, including marker and text sizes.

classes.name: LegendRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores legend rendering info, including font, border, and entries.

classes.name: PlotAreaRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains info for rendering the plot area, including the transformation matrix.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Ensures that the essential Point, LineFormat, and FillFormat are initialized in PointRendererInfo.
